title: Hello v1
description: First frame on a runner->hub connection. The connection is always outbound from the runner (the project container holds no inbound management ports, studio-design S3). Carries protocol/runner version, project identity and capabilities; on a reconnect it also declares per-task resume points (last contiguously-received seq per task) so the hub can replay/re-send anything after them. Forward-compatible envelope: unknown top-level fields are accepted.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol major version the runner speaks.

runner_version.description: Runner build/version string (opaque to the hub).

capabilities.description: Adapter/backends the runner can drive. Open strings; the routing config that consumes them is host policy, not part of this schema.

resume.description: Reconnect declaration: task_id -> last seq the runner has contiguously received from the hub for that task. The hub replays its outbound buffer for each task with seq > this value. Absent/empty on a fresh connection.
